title: Why every AI website looks the same (and how to fix it)
description:
Every AI website looks the same.

That's a default, not a limit.

Purple gradient.

Inter font.

Four cards in a grid.

You've seen it a thousand times.

That's what Claude builds when you just say "make a website."

Not because it can't do better.

Because a vague prompt points it at the average.

It samples the middle of everything it's ever seen.

Give it a real direction and the same model changes completely.

Same engine.

Different taste.

Different result.

Like ordering "just food" at a restaurant.

You get the safe dish.

Never the one you actually wanted.

The talent was never missing.

The direction was.

Aim it right and Claude builds sites people remember.

#claudecode #webdesign #aiwebsites #frontend #aidesign
